from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """Named party involved in the case."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the person or entity")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Role in the case (e.g., Appellant, Appellee, Plaintiff, Defendant)")

class LegalCase(BaseModel):
    """Case identifier and court information."""
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="Official case number, e.g., (2023) 粤 0105 民初 18126 号")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the court")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of case, e.g., Inheritance Dispute, Administrative Review")

class FinancialFact(BaseModel):
    """Specific monetary amounts or fees mentioned."""
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric amount")
    currency: str | None = Field(default="CNY", description="Currency type")
    description: str | None = Field(description="What the amount represents, e.g., 'Case acceptance fee', 'Compensation'")
    payer_or_recipient: str | None = Field(description="Who pays or receives the amount")
    stage: str | None = Field(description="Court stage (e.g., First Instance, Second Instance)")

class RulingDetail(BaseModel):
    """Textual details from the ruling or verdict section."""
    text: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim key phrase or short sentence from the ruling")
    summary: str | None = Field(description="Brief summary of the outcome, e.g., 'Dismiss appeal', 'Maintain original judgment'")
    is_final: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this judgment is final")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Evidence extracted from a single legal document for matching purposes."""
    parties: list[Party]
    legal_cases: list[LegalCase]
    financial_facts: list[FinancialFact]
    rulings: list[RulingDetail]
